dispositions.justification: Retains the post-baseline workflow-guide update through the changed shared knowledge loader. Workflow groups remain informational human paths or unavailable capabilities, not new callable tools or execution authority.
Retains the post-baseline shared-contract update. Moving existing controls does not expand global style keys or alter the automatic-application allowlist.
Retains the post-baseline shared-contract update. Closed field patches, selected scope and original protected-binding checks remain independent of mobile control placement.
Retains the post-baseline shared-contract update. Mobile layout changes introduce no additional section targets, identifier formats or field-creation authority.
Retains the post-baseline shared-contract update. Protected bindings remain checked, and removal of a bound field remains excluded from automatic application.
Retains the post-baseline shared-contract update. Reordering remains a typed private-draft operation subject to selected scope and protected-binding invariants.
Retains the post-baseline shared-contract update. Original section targets and bounded layout patches are unchanged by moving Preview into the mobile menu.
Retains the post-baseline shared-contract update. The exact five-section permutation and repeating-header ordering requirement remain separate from shell layout.
Retains the post-baseline shared-contract update. Logo changes still require an asset descriptor or null; the new share icon grants no asset authority.
Retains the post-baseline shared-contract update. Collection changes retain binding validation and remain excluded from automatic application at every viewport width.
Retains the post-baseline shared-contract update. Heading changes remain stored-text-only and do not enable the header or expand selected scope.
Retains the post-baseline shared-contract update. Heading and page-number typography targets remain explicitly bounded and distinct from mobile page-count presentation.
Retains the post-baseline discovery-contract update. Capability retrieval reports the granted catalog without granting effects or independently establishing answer evidence.
Retains the post-baseline tool and guide updates. Reading a registered guide establishes evidence but grants no additional effects; mobile menu actions do not invoke this tool.
Retains the post-baseline context-contract update. Context retrieval remains a read of the private candidate; moving controls does not add disclosure permissions.
Retains the post-baseline observation-contract update. Inspection captures candidate-bound evidence; compact page labels and collapsed thumbnails do not replace that evidence.

Retains the post-baseline authorized-observation addition. Text permission remains default-off and consumed for one run; opening the floating AI editor grants no observation access. Runtime interaction is UNVERIFIED.
Retains the post-baseline scenario-tool addition. Synthetic scenario diagnostics still do not set the final inspection receipt or authorize completion.
Retains the post-baseline shared-tool update. Successful private undo invalidates inspection and observation evidence and clears the imported source handoff.
Retains the post-baseline shared-tool update. Notes remain bounded and run-local; neither the mobile menu nor thumbnail preferences alter model memory authority.
Retains the post-baseline completion-contract update. Finish still requires a latest ready inspection and current source lineage; source-bound proposals remain excluded from automatic application.
Retains the post-baseline answer-contract update. Exact answer text, prior evidence and latest-receipt checks remain intact; shell controls do not create answer evidence.
Retains the post-baseline blocker-contract update. An assistant-reported blocker still terminates without a proposal; the mobile shell does not reinterpret that outcome.

Retains the post-baseline authoring-guide update. Typed operations, selected scope, protected bindings, observation consent and final inspection remain documented independently of mobile presentation.

Retains the post-baseline pixel-observation addition. Separate default-off text and pixel controls remain present and single-use; hiding thumbnails grants no pixel access. Runtime capture is UNVERIFIED.
Retains the post-baseline source-workspace addition. Listing requires genuine run-owned source authorization; opening More actions or the AI editor does not create it.
Retains the post-baseline source-workspace addition. Reads retain bounded arguments and genuine source authorization; the mobile shell grants no host filesystem or business-value access.
Retains the post-baseline source-workspace addition. Search remains bounded to authorized fictional source, with no permission changes from mobile layout or menu handling.
Retains the post-baseline source-workspace addition. Exact-digest replacement and null-digest creation remain explicit, and source-bound proposals still require human Apply.
Retains the post-baseline source-workspace addition. Closed patch arguments preserve digest, creation and deletion semantics; menu relocation bypasses neither consent nor explicit Apply.
Retains the post-baseline source-workspace addition. Commands retain bounded arguments, empty-string root cwd semantics and genuine source authorization. Runtime isolation is UNVERIFIED.
Retains the post-baseline source-workspace addition. Diff retrieval remains an authorized read against the fictional starter and does not establish artifact acceptance or application approval.
Retains the post-baseline source-workspace addition. Artifact retrieval still requires a successful recorded command and verifies current source and host bindings before returning a descriptor.
Retains the post-baseline typed artifact-import addition. Import uses the shared draft parser, scope and protected-binding checks, invalidates inspection and preserves source lineage.

Retains the post-baseline source-workspace guide addition. Separate single-run consent, artifact lineage, final inspection, explicit human Apply and cleanup blocking remain stated. Runtime behavior is UNVERIFIED.

Retains the recorded post-baseline guide and shared styling updates. Additional tables remain excluded from set_table_style, and the guide preserves exact barcode, source-fact, human import and sharing boundaries. Mobile menu changes grant no authoring effects.

Retains the recorded post-baseline page-contract update. Page and printer declarations remain bounded by closed schemas, and set_page remains outside the automatic-application allowlist. Mobile shell changes introduce no page-setting authority.

Retains the recorded post-baseline independent table-color update. The closed patch remains restricted to items and six-digit hex colors or null. Mobile toolbar styling does not change supported targets, selected scope or operation authority.

Retains the recorded post-baseline typed-operation update. Each draft step still validates selected scope and original protected bindings, then invalidates prior inspection evidence. Menu relocation does not bypass these checks or the final inspection requirement.
